payload.title: Define immutable scorecard and classifier revisions with safe migration
payload.description: Scope: first-class Scorecard and Classifier identities, separately immutable revisions. A scorecard revision pins ordered classifier revision references plus shared request/provider configuration and optimization policies; learned runtime checkpoints are distinct from editable definition revisions. Any classifier change creates a classifier revision and a new affected scorecard revision; never mutate old snapshots. Runs pin scorecard revision; predictions, human feedback and metrics identify classifier definition revision and actual learned configuration fingerprint. Define membership removal, renaming, reorder and multiple scorecard reuse semantics. GraphQL exposes create/read/edit-as-new-revision, revision comparison and explicit active revision selection. SQLite migration must preserve old runs, labels, comments and source provenance, be idempotent and transactional. Acceptance: tests prove edit isolation, joint-request cache invalidation, atomic membership updates, old-run readability and restoration of an old scorecard without overwriting newer history. Audit existing scorecards.py/catalog implementation before extending it; do not equate run numbering with the entire version model.
